p, k = map(int, input().split())
MOD = 1000000007
vis = [False] * p
ans = 1

for i in range(1, p):
    if not vis[i]:
        start = i
        while not vis[start]:
            vis[start] = True
            start = (k * start) % p
        ans = (ans * p) % MOD

if k == 1:
    ans = (ans * p) % MOD

print(ans)
